provenance.requirements_release:
# Latest PyPI releases of the compared frameworks, pinned exactly (resolved 2026-10-21; Python 3.12).
# One virtual environment per framework: compare/setup_venvs.sh creates `<name>` for every `# venv: <name>` section.
# Only the direct dependencies are pinned here; every record under benchmarks/records/ holds the `pip freeze` of
# each environment, which lists the transitive versions that were installed.
#
# venv: langgraph-release
langgraph==1.2.16
langchain-core==1.6.12

# venv: haystack-release
haystack-ai==3.4.0

# venv: pydantic_graph-release
pydantic-graph==2.59.0

# venv: llamaindex-release
llama-index-core==0.14.25
llama-index-workflows==2.26.0

# venv: autogen-release
autogen-agentchat==0.7.5
autogen-core==0.7.5

# venv: pydantic_graph-legacy
# Only benchmarks/compare/probe_pydantic_legacy.py uses this one: pydantic-graph 1.x is the last series with the
# `Graph(nodes=[...])` constructor that the earlier harnesses were written against.
pydantic-graph==1.87.0

# venv: pydantic_graph-legacy-logfire
# The same legacy pydantic-graph with the optional `logfire` package installed beside it, which turns the
# no-op instrumentation spans of pydantic-graph into real ones (benchmarks/compare/probe_pydantic_legacy.py).
pydantic-graph==1.87.0
logfire==5.2.0

# venv: dr_compare
# The deep-research comparison (benchmarks/dr_compare): LangGraph and the imports of its runner. The NeoGraph Python
# module is not installed here; it is built from the source tree in its own build directory, and pybind11 is the
# build-time dependency of that build.
langgraph==1.2.16
langchain-core==1.6.12
langchain-openai==1.7.2
openai==3.35.1
requests==2.34.2
psutil==7.2.2
pydantic==2.14.1
certifi==2026.10.19
pybind11==2.13.6
